[[File:Ore-13.png|thumb|Two chunks of Ore-13 shown on a Bot's upgrade bar.]] 
'''Ore-13''' is a substance used to upgrade Bots and Mods and increase their level. 

Grey, Basic Ore-13 is obtained, among other things, by completing Solo Missions and Raids, Away Missions, Alliance Quests, from some Crystals, and duplicate Mods.

Colored Class Ore-13 gives a bonus if used on the correct Bot class. They are mostly obtained from duplicate Bots, [[Forge|Forging]] Bots, and offers and Daily Deals: 3 Tier 2 and 2 Tier 3 Class Ore-13 are available each day in Daily Deals.

Listed are amounts of Ore-13 and Gold received from duplicate Bots and Mods:
* '''1-Star Bot:''' 2 Tier 1 Class Ore-13, 145 Gold
* '''2-Star Bot:''' 3 Tier 2 Class Ore-13, 3 Tier 1 Class Ore-13, 1057 Gold
* '''3-Star Bot:''' 1 Tier 4 Class Ore-13, 2 Tier 3 Class Ore-13, 1 Tier 2 Class Ore-13, 1510 Gold
* '''4-Star Bot: '''1 Tier 5 Class Ore-13, 4 Tier 4 Class Ore-13, 7102 Gold
* '''5-Star Bot:''' 2 Tier 5 Class Ore-13, 3 Tier 4 Class Ore-13, 3 Tier 3 Class Ore-13, 13528 Gold
* '''1-Star Mod:''' 1 Tier 2 Basic Ore-13, 1 Tier 1 Basic Ore-13
* '''2-Star Mod:''' 2 Tier 2 Basic Ore-13, 20 Gold
* '''3-Star Mod: ''' 13 Tier 3 Ore-13, 574 Gold
* '''4-Star Mod:''' 3 T5 Ore 13, 3,979 Gold
The inventory can hold a limited amount of Ore-13, which is increased as a player levels. Extra ore earned are put in the stash until they expire, are sold, or more space is made by using Ore-13 in the inventory.
